news.title: MemeCore's M token suddenly crashes 80% with no clear trigger
news.summary: The token fell from nearly $3 to about $0.50 in hours, wiping out close to $3 billion in market value, with no exploit or announcement to explain it. Onchain investigator ZachXBT warned in April that M's price had been propped up by insiders.

news.title: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin goes live in Japan after regulatory approval
news.summary: Japan's financial regulator cleared the U.S. dollar-backed token as a new category of payment instrument, letting SBI VC Trade offer it to institutions and retail. RLUSD remains small, at about $1.7 billion.

news.title: Bitcoin has a new line in the sand. Thursday’s core PCE could stress test it.
news.summary: The market has found a new support level and it could be tested following Thursday's U.S. inflation data.

news.title: XRP slides 2.8% as weak bounce keeps $1 support in focus
news.summary: Sellers broke another support level on heavy volume, while the recovery failed to reclaim the zone that would ease downside pressure.

news.title: Bitcoin back above $60,000, ETH, SOL recoup losses as AI stocks stage rebound
news.summary: The token fell to about $59,000 before buyers stepped in, but the week's losses are steep across the board. A blowout Micron forecast lifted stocks and oil kept sliding, yet crypto did not follow.

news.title: Upheaval at the Ethereum Foundation has some of crypto’s biggest names feeling bullish
news.summary: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're looking at Ethereum's eventful week that started off with the launch of EthLabs, plus the layoffs at the Ethereum Foundation, and what this all means for the network.

news.title: Kalshi targets a massive $40 billion valuation, widening lead over rival Polymarket
news.summary: The prediction market operator, which is eyeing a potential public debut in 2027, could close a new funding round in Q3, according to a Financial Times report.

news.title: Binance withdraws Greek MiCA bid but vows to remain in Europe
news.summary: The crypto giant must find a home base in the EU by July 1 or regulators will force the company to shut down operations for millions of regional users.

news.title: Tesla and Waymo duel in the robotaxi race — but the company spending the most builds no cars at all
news.summary: Uber is quietly writing $500 million checks to lock in robotaxis as Waymo threatens to leave it behind.

news.title: Why SK Hynix’s $30 billion U.S. listing could be a double-edged sword for Micron’s stock
news.summary: The South Korean memory company could give investors more opportunities beyond Micron, though it may also raise awareness of industry dynamics.

news.title: These hidden PCE triggers could force a Fed rate hike — and shock the market
news.summary: The PCE inflation report will either calm Wall Street or ignite fears of a restrictive Fed.

news.title: Everyone on Wall Street now believes in buying the dip. That is exactly why you should worry.
news.summary: A strategy that feels like free money actually lags the stock market over the long term.

news.title: My houseguest left heat marks all over my table. I didn’t notice them until she was gone. Do I ask her to pay to remove them?
news.summary: “What drives me crazy is that she didn’t mention it.”

news.title: I had gallbladder surgery. After I got home, the hospital asked me for a financial donation. Is this ethical?
news.summary: “The letter asked whether I had a favorite caregiver and if I would like to make a contribution in their honor.”

news.title: Qualcomm’s stock is soaring as these big numbers excite Wall Street
news.summary: Shares of Qualcomm soared on Wednesday after the company announced new revenue targets and a partership with Meta Platforms.
